skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting proper or improper fractions with a common denominator.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer or whole number parts of mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole number part to complete fractional subtraction when the fractional difference is negative.

skills.name: Simplifying Fractions
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its simplest form or lowest terms.
